gui.wifi.signgui.tip_line1: §eUse '&&' for a literal '&'. Section codes such as '&a' or '&l' still work inline; the B I U S O toggles (Ctrl+B/I/U/T/K) apply to the whole line.
gui.wifi.signgui.tip_line2: §e§lNOTE: §fEditing a sign on a server needs this mod installed on the server as well.
